输入 sqrt、frac、sum，或直接书写数学表达式: Type sqrt, frac, or sum, or enter a math expression.
用生成的公式替换剪贴板: Copy the generated formula to the clipboard
鼠标可直接定位数学光标: Click to position the math caret
选择补全候选，继续打字仍可筛选: Choose a suggestion. Continue typing to filter.
接受候选 → 完成当前模板 → 提交公式: Accept a suggestion, finish the template, or submit the formula.
候选打开时，包裹选区或左侧数学项: Wrap the selection or the math term on the left.
下一个 / 上一个参数，未改动时保留默认值: Move between parameters. Unedited defaults are kept.
跨过当前层级的数学项: Move across a term at the current level.
按方向扩展结构选区，反向收缩: Expand or shrink the structural selection.
跳出最近数学容器，阻止页面导航: Move out of the nearest math structure.
解除安全的函数、根式或括号外壳: Unwrap a supported function, radical, or bracket.
扩展结构选区 / 按原路径收缩: Expand or reverse the structural selection.
撤销 / 重做；Ctrl + Shift + Z 也可重做: Undo or redo. Ctrl + Shift + Z also redoes.
先关闭候选，再清除结构选区，最后取消；草稿保留: Close suggestions, clear the selection, or cancel. Your draft is kept.
自动粘贴会核对原窗口与输入控件。无法确认目标或剪贴板含其他格式时，结果保留供手动: Auto-paste checks the original input. If it cannot paste safely, the result stays available for copying.
本机存储不可用，请及时复制编辑结果: Local storage is unavailable. Copy your result to keep it.
请先输入需要保存的公式: Enter a formula before saving a template.
输出格式未能保存到本机: Could not save the output format.
↑ ↓ 选择 · Enter 插入 · Shift Enter 包裹: ↑ ↓ Choose · Enter Insert · Shift Enter Wrap
↑ ↓ 或点击选择公式来源: Choose a formula source with ↑ ↓ or a click
Tab 下一个参数 · Enter 完成当前模板: Tab Next field · Enter Finish template
结果暂未能持久保存，请使用“仅复制”: Could not save the result. Use Copy only.
提交时尝试粘贴到原输入框: Try to paste into the original input on submit
每行一项，例如 sqrt=kg,pfg: One per line, for example sqrt=kg,pfg
“仅复制”会用公式替换剪贴板。自动粘贴仅临时使用可安全恢复的纯文本剪贴板；图片、: Copy only replaces the clipboard with the formula. Auto-paste preserves images, files, and other formats and offers manual copy when needed.
快捷键格式示例：Ctrl+Alt+M 或 Ctrl+Shift+M: Use a shortcut such as Ctrl+Alt+M or Ctrl+Shift+M.
界面缩放须为 65% 到 125%: UI scale must be between 65% and 125%.
别名必须以英文字母开头，且只能包含字母和数字: Aliases must start with an ASCII letter and contain only letters and digits.
行数和列数须为正整数: Rows and columns must be positive integers.
行列式的行数和列数必须相同: A determinant requires a square matrix.
按行编辑矩阵单元格: Edit matrix cells in row order.
放弃未保存的表单内容并返回编辑器？: Discard unsaved changes and return to the editor?
从上次成功保存的备份恢复公式库？当前损坏文件会另存保留。: Restore the last saved backup? The damaged file will be kept separately.
替换同 ID 的现有用户包（保留启用状态）: Replace the existing pack with this ID and keep its enabled state
将光标放在 LaTeX 中需要填参的位置，再“添加参数并插入槽位”。分组花括号与: Place the caret in the LaTeX template, then click Add parameter and insert slot. The preview checks braces and parameter slots.
输入 LaTeX 后将在此显示数学预览: Enter LaTeX to preview the formula.
内置包不可删除: The built-in pack cannot be deleted.
此存储没有恢复接口: This storage does not support recovery.
基础数学包不可替换；请更换导入包的 ID: Basic Math cannot be replaced. Choose a different import ID.
不支持的字段；请使用受支持的 Schema，不能静默丢弃字段: Unsupported field. Use the supported schema.
已复制，可粘贴到需要的位置: Copied. Paste the formula where you need it.
浏览器预览模式：请使用“仅复制”；全局快捷键与原窗口粘贴在桌面程序中可用: Browser preview uses Copy only. The desktop app supports global shortcuts and auto-paste.
所属包不存在: The destination pack no longer exists.
目标包存在同 ID 的公式: The destination pack already contains that formula ID.
Tab 切换参数 · Enter 结束当前模板 · Ctrl Space 选择嵌: Tab changes fields, Enter finishes the template, and Ctrl Space opens suggestions for a nested template. Test input stays in this panel.
对一个数学项取平方根: Take the square root of a math term
已复制公式，剪贴板现为生成结果: The formula is on the clipboard.
请先在普通输入框中使用全局快捷键呼出；当前结果保留，可使用“仅复制”: Open Math Input from a normal input field with the global shortcut. You can copy the current formula.
已发送粘贴快捷键；原纯文本剪贴板已恢复（或保留了新的剪贴板内容）。请在目标应用确: Sent the paste shortcut. The clipboard was restored or newer clipboard contents were kept. Check the result in the target app.
已发送粘贴快捷键；剪贴板恢复失败，生成结果仍可手动复制，请确认目标结果: Sent the paste shortcut. Clipboard restore failed. Check the target app or copy the saved result.
Windows 目标响应超时，已停止自动操作，结果保留供手动复制: The target app timed out. Copy the saved result manually.
请在目标输入框中使用全局快捷键呼出 Math Input: Use the global shortcut from the target input to open Math Input.
未确认是可用的普通文本输入框，请手动复制: Could not verify a plain text input. Copy the formula manually.
原窗口或输入控件已关闭，请手动复制: The original window or input closed. Copy the formula manually.
公式为空、过长或含无效字符: The formula is empty, too long, or contains an invalid character.
公式库已在另一个窗口变化，请重新打开后再保存: The formula library changed in another window. Reopen it before saving.
没有可恢复的公式库备份: No formula library backup is available.
默认值不能再声明参数槽位: Default values cannot contain parameter slots.
须为小写英文字母开头的字母、数字或短横线；不能含路径字符: Start with a lowercase ASCII letter. Use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
命令须为小写字母开头，只能包含字母、数字: Commands must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters and digits.
包裹目标必须是已声明参数: The wrap target must be a declared parameter.
不支持的存储版本或无效修订号: Unsupported storage version or invalid revision.
公式包 ID 已存在或被内置包保留: The pack ID is duplicated or reserved.
本地公式库超过大小上限: The formula library exceeds its size limit.
此处没有可安全解除的函数、根式或成对括号；分式和带指数的函数不会被改写: No supported function, radical, or paired bracket at the selection.
为底数添加指数: Add an exponent to a base
带上下界的累加式: Sum with lower and upper limits
随每次求和递增的索引: The index that changes at each term
索引的终止值，包含在求和内: Final index, included in the sum
变量趋近某值时的极限: Limit as a variable approaches a value
发生变化的变量: The variable that approaches the target
带上下限与积分变量: Integral with limits and a variable
传入三角函数的角度或表达式: Angle or expression passed to the function
没有经全局快捷键捕获的输入目标，请手动复制: Open Math Input with the global shortcut or copy the formula manually.
原输入目标已失效，请手动复制: The original input is no longer available. Copy the formula manually.
Windows 请求已过期，已停止自动操作，请手动复制: The Windows request expired. Copy the formula manually.
无法确认当前输入桌面，已停止自动粘贴: Could not verify the input desktop. Auto-paste stopped.
当前是受保护的系统桌面，已停止自动粘贴: Auto-paste stopped on a protected system desktop.
无权核验目标进程，请使用手动复制: Could not verify the target process. Copy the formula manually.
无法确认目标进程身份: Could not verify the target process identity.
此目标属于系统保护窗口或命令终端，请手动复制: The target is a protected system window or terminal. Copy the formula manually.
无法确认目标进程生命周期: Could not verify the lifetime of the target process.
无法确认目标权限级别: Could not verify the target permission level.
无法识别原输入控件，请手动复制: Could not identify the original input. Copy the formula manually.
无法确认输入框是否受保护: Could not verify whether the input is protected.
无法确认输入控件类型: Could not verify the input type.
无法确认输入控件进程: Could not verify the input process.
无法确认输入控件状态: Could not verify the state of the input.
密码或受保护输入框不允许自动粘贴: Auto-paste is unavailable in password or protected inputs.
Windows UI Automation 不可用，请手动复制: Windows UI Automation is unavailable. Copy the formula manually.
目标以管理员权限运行，请手动复制；不会提升本程序权限: The target runs as administrator. Copy the formula manually.
无法记录原输入焦点，请手动复制: Could not record the original input focus. Copy the formula manually.
捕获期间前台窗口发生变化，已放弃目标: The foreground window changed while capturing the target.
原窗口身份已变化，请手动复制: The original window changed. Copy the formula manually.
系统未允许恢复原窗口焦点，请手动复制: Windows did not allow restoring focus. Copy the formula manually.
原窗口未获得前台焦点，请手动复制: The original window could not be focused. Copy the formula manually.
前台窗口发生变化，已停止粘贴: The foreground window changed. Paste stopped.
原输入焦点已变化，已停止粘贴: The original input focus changed. Paste stopped.
输入控件身份不一致，已停止粘贴: The input no longer matches. Paste stopped.
剪贴板已变化，已停止粘贴并保留最新内容: The clipboard changed. The latest contents were kept and paste stopped.
Windows 未接收完整粘贴按键，可能存在权限边界，请手动复制: Windows did not receive the entire paste shortcut. Copy the formula manually.
请松开修饰键后重试，未模拟释放用户按键: Release the modifier keys and retry.
剪贴板正被占用或无法访问，请稍后手动复制: The clipboard is busy or inaccessible. Try copying again later.
无法枚举剪贴板格式，已保留原剪贴板: Could not enumerate formats. The clipboard was kept.
快捷键已被占用或无法注册: The shortcut is busy or could not be registered
全局快捷键注册失败: Could not register the global shortcut
无法替换旧快捷键: Could not replace the previous shortcut
公式库已经变化；请重新载入后再保存: The formula library changed. Reload it before saving.
